title: Redstone Logic Gates
description: Add logic gates as redstone components.
body:
# Redstone Logic Gates
This mod adds multiple core logic gates as redstone components, operating similarly to redstone repeaters and comparators. 

## How to Use
**Prerequisites**: You will need Fabric and the Fabric API for this mod to work. If you wish to use this on a server it will need to be included there as well.
1. Craft a redstone core using one nether quartz and four redstone dust.
2. Craft a redstone workbench using two planks of any kind and two iron ingots.
3. Open the redstone workbench interface, and place a redstone core in the item slot.
4. Choose your desired logic gates in the menu to the right.
5. Place your new redstone logic gates in your world to build awesome redstone contraptions!
